title: Shopify Store Radar
description: Enter Shopify store domains. Get back every product with price, discount, stock and — from the second run on — exactly what changed since last time.

stores.title: Shopify store domains
stores.description: One domain per entry, e.g. `allbirds.com`, `gymshark.com`, `fashionnova.com`. Full URLs work too — they get normalized. Up to 50 stores per run.

maxProductsPerStore.title: Max products per store
maxProductsPerStore.description: Stop after this many products for each store. One product = one result item. Set 0 to take the whole catalog.

detectChanges.title: Detect changes since last run
detectChanges.description: Compare against the snapshot stored by the previous run of this actor and tag each product with `changeType`: new / delisted / price_drop / price_rise / sold_out / back_in_stock. The snapshot is kept per store between runs. Turn this off for a plain catalog dump.

onlyChanges.title: Output only changed products
onlyChanges.description: Return only the products that actually changed. Much cheaper if you run this on a daily schedule — you pay per returned item. The very first run always returns everything to establish the baseline.

includeDelisted.title: Report delisted products
includeDelisted.description: When a product seen in the previous run is gone from the catalog, emit a row with `changeType: "delisted"` (title and last known price kept, current price fields empty). Turn off if you only care about products that still exist.

includeSitemap.title: Include sitemap last-modified dates
includeSitemap.description: UCP does not expose a publish date, so `sitemapUpdatedAt` is taken from the store's product sitemap. It tells you when the merchant last touched a product page — a useful proxy for 'recently changed', but not proof of a new listing. Adds a few seconds per store.

pageDelaySec.title: Delay between pages (seconds)
pageDelaySec.description: Gap between catalog page requests. Stores throttle bursty paging — 1s is safe for normal stores; very large catalogs may need 2–3s to avoid a long cool-down.

requestTimeoutSec.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSec.description: Per-request timeout when talking to the store. Large catalogs on slow stores may need more.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Most Shopify stores answer fine from datacenter IPs (5 of 6 tested). A minority block them and return `403` — for those, enable Apify Proxy (residential works best). Leave off to keep runs free.

agentProfileUrl.title: Agent profile URL (advanced)
agentProfileUrl.description: UCP requires every request to reference a public agent profile document that the store fetches and validates. The actor defaults to its own hosted profile — only change this if you host your own copy (the document must contain `ucp.version`, `ucp.services`, `ucp.capabilities` and `ucp.payment_handlers`).
